   201→/// Convert DevcontainerJson fields to RepoHints.
   202→///
   203→/// Maps:
   204→/// - `image` → `hints.image`
   205→/// - `build` → `hints.dockerfile`
   206→/// - `forwardPorts` → `hints.ports`
   207→/// - `containerEnv` → `hints.env`
   208→/// - `postCreateCommand` → `hints.setup`
   209→/// - `mounts` (volume type, /workspace/* target) → `hints.anonymous_volumes`
   210→pub fn to_repo_hints(dc: &DevcontainerJson, devcontainer_dir: &Path) -> RepoHints {
   211→    let mut hints = RepoHints::default();
   212→
   213→    // Image (mutually exclusive with build)
   214→    if let Some(ref image) = dc.image {
   215→        hints.image = image.clone();
   216→    }
   217→
   218→    // Build → DockerfileBuild
   219→    if let Some(ref build) = dc.build
   220→        && build.dockerfile.is_some()
   221→    {
   222→        hints.dockerfile = Some(crate::config::DockerfileBuild {
   223→            path: build
   224→                .dockerfile
   225→                .clone()
   226→                .unwrap_or_else(|| "Dockerfile".to_string()),
   227→            context: build.context.clone().unwrap_or_else(|| ".".to_string()),
   228→            args: build.args.clone().unwrap_or_default(),
   229→            target: build.target.clone(),
   230→            base_dir: Some(devcontainer_dir.to_path_buf()),
   231→        });
   232→    }
   233→
   234→    // Ports
   235→    if let Some(ref ports) = dc.forward_ports {
   236→        hints.ports = ports.iter().filter_map(|p| p.to_port()).collect();
   237→    }
   238→
   239→    // Environment variables
   240→    if let Some(ref env) = dc.container_env {
   241→        hints.env = env.clone();
   242→    }
   243→
   244→    // Setup command
   245→    if let Some(ref cmd) = dc.post_create_command {
   246→        let shell_cmd = cmd.to_shell_command();
   247→        if !shell_cmd.is_empty() {
   248→            hints.setup = Some(shell_cmd);
   249→        }
   250→    }
   251→
   252→    // Anonymous volumes from mounts
   253→    if let Some(ref mounts) = dc.mounts {
   254→        let extra_volumes: Vec<String> = mounts
   255→            .iter()
   256→            .filter_map(|m| m.as_anonymous_volume())
   257→            .collect();
   258→        if !extra_volumes.is_empty() {
   259→            for vol in extra_volumes {
   260→                if !hints.anonymous_volumes.contains(&vol) {
   261→                    hints.anonymous_volumes.push(vol);
   262→                }
   263→            }
   264→        }
   265→    }
   266→
   267→    hints
   268→}
   269→
   270→/// Load devcontainer.json from a workspace and convert to RepoHints.
   271→/// Returns None if no devcontainer.json exists or it fails to parse.
   272→pub fn load_devcontainer_as_hints(workspace_dir: &Path) -> Option<RepoHints> {
   273→    let path = find_devcontainer_json(workspace_dir)?;
   274→    let devcontainer_dir = path.parent().unwrap_or(workspace_dir);
   275→    let contents = std::fs::read_to_string(&path).ok()?;
   276→    let dc = parse_devcontainer(&contents).ok()?;
   277→    Some(to_repo_hints(&dc, devcontainer_dir))
   278→}

pub fn to_repo_hints(dc: &DevcontainerJson, devcontainer_dir: &Path) -> RepoHints {
    let mut hints = RepoHints::default();

    // Image (mutually exclusive with build)
    if let Some(ref image) = dc.image {
        hints.image = image.clone();
    }

    // Build → DockerfileBuild
    if let Some(ref build) = dc.build
        && build.dockerfile.is_some()
    {
        hints.dockerfile = Some(crate::config::DockerfileBuild {
            path: build
                .dockerfile
                .clone()
                .unwrap_or_else(|| "Dockerfile".to_string()),
            context: build.context.clone().unwrap_or_else(|| ".".to_string()),
            args: build.args.clone().unwrap_or_default(),
            target: build.target.clone(),
            base_dir: Some(devcontainer_dir.to_path_buf()),
        });
    }

    // Ports
    if let Some(ref ports) = dc.forward_ports {
        hints.ports = ports.iter().filter_map(|p| p.to_port()).collect();
    }

    // Environment variables
    if let Some(ref env) = dc.container_env {
        hints.env = env.clone();
    }

    // Setup command
    if let Some(ref cmd) = dc.post_create_command {
        let shell_cmd = cmd.to_shell_command();
        if !shell_cmd.is_empty() {
            hints.setup = Some(shell_cmd);
        }
    }

    // Anonymous volumes from mounts
    if let Some(ref mounts) = dc.mounts {
        let extra_volumes: Vec<String> = mounts
            .iter()
            .filter_map(|m| m.as_anonymous_volume())
            .collect();
        if !extra_volumes.is_empty() {
            for vol in extra_volumes {
                if !hints.anonymous_volumes.contains(&vol) {
                    hints.anonymous_volumes.push(vol);
                }
            }
        }
    }

    hints
}
```

fn check_deprecated_fields(contents: &str, path: &Path) {
    let deprecated = [
        ("image", "image"),
        ("ports", "forwardPorts"),
        ("setup", "postCreateCommand"),
        ("[env]", "containerEnv"),
    ];

    for (old_field, new_field) in &deprecated {
        // Check for the field as a top-level key (not in a comment)
        for line in contents.lines() {
            let trimmed = line.trim();
            if trimmed.starts_with('#') {
                continue;
            }
            let matches = if *old_field == "[env]" {
                trimmed == "[env]"
            } else {
                trimmed.starts_with(&format!("{old_field} "))
                    || trimmed.starts_with(&format!("{old_field}="))
            };
            if matches {
                warn!(
                    "{}: '{}' should be moved to devcontainer.json as '{}'. \
                     Container config fields in .dual.toml are deprecated.",
                    path.display(),
                    old_field,
                    new_field
                );
                break;
            }
        }
    }
}

   149→/// Load RepoHints from a workspace directory.
   150→///
   151→/// Loading flow:
   152→/// 1. Read `.dual.toml` → `DualConfig` (defaults if missing)
   153→/// 2. Resolve devcontainer.json path (explicit from DualConfig or auto-detect)
   154→/// 3. Parse devcontainer.json → `RepoHints` for container fields
   155→/// 4. Merge DualConfig fields + devcontainer RepoHints → final `RepoHints`
   156→pub fn load_hints(workspace_dir: &Path) -> Result<RepoHints, HintsError> {
   157→    let dual_config = load_dual_config(workspace_dir)?;
   158→    let dc_path = resolve_devcontainer_path(workspace_dir, &dual_config);
   159→
   160→    // Load container config from devcontainer.json
   161→    let dc_hints = dc_path.and_then(|path| {
   162→        let devcontainer_dir = path.parent().unwrap_or(workspace_dir);
   163→        let contents = std::fs::read_to_string(&path).ok()?;
   164→        let dc = crate::devcontainer::parse_devcontainer(&contents).ok()?;
   165→        Some(crate::devcontainer::to_repo_hints(&dc, devcontainer_dir))
   166→    });
   167→
   168→    Ok(merge_config(&dual_config, dc_hints.as_ref()))
   169→}

   171→/// Load DualConfig from .dual.toml. Returns defaults if file doesn't exist.
   172→fn load_dual_config(workspace_dir: &Path) -> Result<DualConfig, HintsError> {
   173→    let path = workspace_dir.join(HINTS_FILENAME);
   174→
   175→    if !path.exists() {
   176→        return Ok(DualConfig::default());
   177→    }
   178→
   179→    let contents =
   180→        std::fs::read_to_string(&path).map_err(|e| HintsError::ReadError(path.clone(), e))?;
   181→
   182→    // Check for deprecated fields and warn
   183→    check_deprecated_fields(&contents, &path);
   184→
   185→    let config: DualConfig =
   186→        toml::from_str(&contents).map_err(|e| HintsError::ParseError(path, e))?;
   187→    Ok(config)
   188→}

   190→/// Warn if .dual.toml contains deprecated container config fields.
   191→fn check_deprecated_fields(contents: &str, path: &Path) {
   192→    let deprecated = [
   193→        ("image", "image"),
   194→        ("ports", "forwardPorts"),
   195→        ("setup", "postCreateCommand"),
   196→        ("[env]", "containerEnv"),
   197→    ];
   198→
   199→    for (old_field, new_field) in &deprecated {
   200→        // Check for the field as a top-level key (not in a comment)
   201→        for line in contents.lines() {
   202→            let trimmed = line.trim();
   203→            if trimmed.starts_with('#') {
   204→                continue;
   205→            }
   206→            let matches = if *old_field == "[env]" {
   207→                trimmed == "[env]"
   208→            } else {
   209→                trimmed.starts_with(&format!("{old_field} "))
   210→                    || trimmed.starts_with(&format!("{old_field}="))
   211→            };
   212→            if matches {
   213→                warn!(
   214→                    "{}: '{}' should be moved to devcontainer.json as '{}'. \
   215→                     Container config fields in .dual.toml are deprecated.",
   216→                    path.display(),
   217→                    old_field,
   218→                    new_field
   219→                );
   220→                break;
   221→            }
   222→        }
   223→    }
   224→}

   229→fn resolve_devcontainer_path(workspace_dir: &Path, config: &DualConfig) -> Option<PathBuf> {

   236→            "devcontainer path '{}' specified in .dual.toml does not exist",
   237→            path.display()

   239→        return None;

   242→    crate::devcontainer::find_devcontainer_json(workspace_dir)

   249→fn merge_config(dual: &DualConfig, dc_hints: Option<&RepoHints>) -> RepoHints {

   254→        image: base.image,

   272→#
   273→# Container config (image, ports, setup, env) goes in devcontainer.json.

   282→# extra_commands = []
   283→

   285→# These directories get their own volume so they don't sync between host/container

   287→# anonymous_volumes = ["node_modules"]

   353→/// Encode a branch name for filesystem use.
   354→/// Replaces `/` with `__` (double underscore).
   355→/// e.g. "feat/auth" → "feat__auth"
   356→pub fn encode_branch(branch: &str) -> String {
   357→    branch.replace('/', "__")
   358→}
   359→
   360→/// Decode an encoded branch name back to the original.
   361→/// Replaces `__` with `/`.
   362→/// e.g. "feat__auth" → "feat/auth"
   363→pub fn decode_branch(encoded: &str) -> String {
   364→    encoded.replace("__", "/")
   365→}

    77→impl CommandSpec {

    79→    /// - String: returned as-is
    80→    /// - Array: joined with spaces
    81→    /// - Object: values joined with " && "
    82→    pub fn to_shell_command(&self) -> String {
    83→        match self {
    84→            CommandSpec::String(s) => s.clone(),
    85→            CommandSpec::Array(arr) => arr.join(" "),
    86→            CommandSpec::Object(map) => {
    87→                let commands: Vec<String> = map
    88→                    .values()
    89→                    .map(|v| match v {
    90→                        StringOrArray::String(s) => s.clone(),
    91→                        StringOrArray::Array(arr) => arr.join(" "),
    92→                    })
    93→                    .collect();
    94→                commands.join(" && ")
    95→            }
    96→        }
    97→    }

   108→/// Mount specification — devcontainer allows string or object forms.
   109→#[derive(Debug, Deserialize)]
   110→#[serde(untagged)]
   111→pub enum MountSpec {
   112→    /// Docker mount syntax: "type=volume,target=/workspace/node_modules"
   113→    String(String),
   114→    /// Structured mount object
   115→    Object(MountObject),
   116→}
   117→
   118→/// Structured mount configuration.
   119→#[derive(Debug, Deserialize)]
   120→#[serde(rename_all = "camelCase")]
   121→pub struct MountObject {
   122→    #[serde(rename = "type")]
   123→    pub mount_type: Option<String>,
   124→    pub source: Option<String>,
   125→    pub target: String,
   126→}
   127→
   128→const WORKSPACE_PREFIX: &str = "/workspace/";
   129→
   130→impl MountSpec {
   131→    /// Extract anonymous volume path if this is a volume mount targeting /workspace/*.
   132→    /// Returns the relative path (e.g., "node_modules" from "/workspace/node_modules").
   133→    pub fn as_anonymous_volume(&self) -> Option<String> {
   134→        match self {
   135→            MountSpec::String(s) => {
   136→                // Parse "type=volume,target=/workspace/node_modules" format
   137→                let mut mount_type = None;
   138→                let mut target = None;
   139→                let mut has_source = false;
   140→                for part in s.split(',') {
   141→                    let (key, value) = part.split_once('=')?;
   142→                    match key.trim() {
   143→                        "type" => mount_type = Some(value.trim()),
   144→                        "target" | "dst" | "destination" => target = Some(value.trim()),
   145→                        "source" | "src" => has_source = true,
   146→                        _ => {}
   147→                    }
   148→                }
   149→                if mount_type == Some("volume") && !has_source {
   150→                    target
   151→                        .filter(|t| t.starts_with(WORKSPACE_PREFIX))
   152→                        .map(|t| t[WORKSPACE_PREFIX.len()..].to_string())
   153→                } else {
   154→                    None
   155→                }
   156→            }
   157→            MountSpec::Object(obj) => {
   158→                if obj.mount_type.as_deref() == Some("volume")
   159→                    && obj.source.is_none()
   160→                    && obj.target.starts_with(WORKSPACE_PREFIX)
   161→                {
   162→                    return Some(obj.target[WORKSPACE_PREFIX.len()..].to_string());
   163→                }
   164→                None
   165→            }
   166→        }
   167→    }
   168→}

   170→/// Resolve the path to devcontainer.json in a workspace directory.
   171→///
   172→/// Checks in order:
   173→/// 1. `.devcontainer/devcontainer.json`
   174→/// 2. `.devcontainer.json` (root)
   175→///
   176→/// Returns None if neither exists.
   177→pub fn find_devcontainer_json(workspace_dir: &Path) -> Option<PathBuf> {
   178→    let candidates = [
   179→        workspace_dir
   180→            .join(".devcontainer")
   181→            .join("devcontainer.json"),
   182→        workspace_dir.join(".devcontainer.json"),
   183→    ];
   184→
   185→    candidates.into_iter().find(|p| p.exists())
   186→}

   191→}

   193→/// Load and parse devcontainer.json from a workspace directory.
   194→/// Returns None if no devcontainer.json exists.
   195→pub fn load_devcontainer(workspace_dir: &Path) -> Option<DevcontainerJson> {
   196→    let path = find_devcontainer_json(workspace_dir)?;
   197→    let contents = std::fs::read_to_string(&path).ok()?;
   198→    parse_devcontainer(&contents).ok()
   199→}

   201→/// Convert DevcontainerJson fields to RepoHints.
   202→///
   203→/// Maps:
   204→/// - `image` → `hints.image`
   205→/// - `build` → `hints.dockerfile`
   206→/// - `forwardPorts` → `hints.ports`
   207→/// - `containerEnv` → `hints.env`
   208→/// - `postCreateCommand` → `hints.setup`
   209→/// - `mounts` (volume type, /workspace/* target) → `hints.anonymous_volumes`
   210→pub fn to_repo_hints(dc: &DevcontainerJson, devcontainer_dir: &Path) -> RepoHints {
   211→    let mut hints = RepoHints::default();
   212→
   213→    // Image (mutually exclusive with build)
   214→    if let Some(ref image) = dc.image {
   215→        hints.image = image.clone();
   216→    }
   217→
   218→    // Build → DockerfileBuild
   219→    if let Some(ref build) = dc.build
   220→        && build.dockerfile.is_some()
   221→    {
   222→        hints.dockerfile = Some(crate::config::DockerfileBuild {
   223→            path: build
   224→                .dockerfile
   225→                .clone()
   226→                .unwrap_or_else(|| "Dockerfile".to_string()),
   227→            context: build.context.clone().unwrap_or_else(|| ".".to_string()),
   228→            args: build.args.clone().unwrap_or_default(),
   229→            target: build.target.clone(),
   230→            base_dir: Some(devcontainer_dir.to_path_buf()),
   231→        });
   232→    }
   233→
   234→    // Ports
   235→    if let Some(ref ports) = dc.forward_ports {
   236→        hints.ports = ports.iter().filter_map(|p| p.to_port()).collect();
   237→    }
   238→
   239→    // Environment variables
   240→    if let Some(ref env) = dc.container_env {
   241→        hints.env = env.clone();
   242→    }
   243→
   244→    // Setup command
   245→    if let Some(ref cmd) = dc.post_create_command {
   246→        let shell_cmd = cmd.to_shell_command();
   247→        if !shell_cmd.is_empty() {
   248→            hints.setup = Some(shell_cmd);
   249→        }
   250→    }
   251→
   252→    // Anonymous volumes from mounts
   253→    if let Some(ref mounts) = dc.mounts {
   254→        let extra_volumes: Vec<String> = mounts
   255→            .iter()
   256→            .filter_map(|m| m.as_anonymous_volume())
   257→            .collect();
   258→        if !extra_volumes.is_empty() {
   259→            for vol in extra_volumes {
   260→                if !hints.anonymous_volumes.contains(&vol) {
   261→                    hints.anonymous_volumes.push(vol);
   262→                }
   263→            }
   264→        }
   265→    }
   266→
   267→    hints
   268→}
   269→
   270→/// Load devcontainer.json from a workspace and convert to RepoHints.
   271→/// Returns None if no devcontainer.json exists or it fails to parse.
   272→pub fn load_devcontainer_as_hints(workspace_dir: &Path) -> Option<RepoHints> {
   273→    let path = find_devcontainer_json(workspace_dir)?;
   274→    let devcontainer_dir = path.parent().unwrap_or(workspace_dir);
   275→    let contents = std::fs::read_to_string(&path).ok()?;
   276→    let dc = parse_devcontainer(&contents).ok()?;
   277→    Some(to_repo_hints(&dc, devcontainer_dir))
   278→}

    29→/// Generate shell RC content that intercepts runtime commands for a workspace.
    30→///
    31→/// The generated content defines shell functions that wrap `docker exec`
    32→/// for each command that should route to the container. These functions
    33→/// handle TTY detection automatically.
    34→///
    35→/// # Arguments
    36→/// * `container_name` - The Docker container name (e.g. "dual-lightfast-main")
    37→/// * `extra_commands` - Additional commands to route to the container
    38→pub fn generate_rc(container_name: &str, extra_commands: &[String]) -> String {
    39→    let mut rc = String::new();
    40→
    41→    rc.push_str("# Generated by dual — do not edit\n");
    42→    rc.push_str(&format!(
    43→        "# Shell interceptors for container: {container_name}\n\n"
    44→    ));
    45→
    46→    // Set the container name as an environment variable for reference
    47→    rc.push_str(&format!("export DUAL_CONTAINER=\"{container_name}\"\n\n"));
    48→
    49→    // Generate a function for each default container command
    50→    for cmd in CONTAINER_COMMANDS {
    51→        rc.push_str(&generate_function(cmd, container_name));
    52→        rc.push('\n');
    53→    }
    54→
    55→    // Generate a function for each extra command
    56→    for cmd in extra_commands {
    57→        if !CONTAINER_COMMANDS.contains(&cmd.as_str()) {
    58→            rc.push_str(&generate_function(cmd, container_name));
    59→            rc.push('\n');
    60→        }
    61→    }
    62→
    63→    rc
    64→}

    66→/// Generate a single shell function that intercepts a command.
    67→///
    68→/// The function:
    69→/// - Detects if stdout is a TTY and passes -t to docker exec if so
    70→/// - Forwards all arguments to the command inside the container
    71→/// - Preserves exit codes
    72→fn generate_function(command: &str, container_name: &str) -> String {
    73→    format!(
    74→        r#"{command}() {{
    75→    if [ -t 1 ]; then
    76→        command docker exec -t -w /workspace {container_name} {command} "$@"
    77→    else
    78→        command docker exec -w /workspace {container_name} {command} "$@"
    79→    fi
    80→}}
    81→"#
    82→    )
    83→}

### Overview
The `load_hints()` function merges DualConfig from `.dual.toml` (Dual-specific orchestration settings) with container configuration from `devcontainer.json` to produce a unified `RepoHints` struct consumed throughout the codebase. This architecture makes devcontainer.json the primary source for container settings while allowing `.dual.toml` to add Dual-specific features like command routing and shared file propagation.

pub fn load_hints(workspace_dir: &Path) -> Result<RepoHints, HintsError> {
    let dual_config = load_dual_config(workspace_dir)?;
    let dc_path = resolve_devcontainer_path(workspace_dir, &dual_config);

    // Load container config from devcontainer.json
    let dc_hints = dc_path.and_then(|path| {
        let devcontainer_dir = path.parent().unwrap_or(workspace_dir);
        let contents = std::fs::read_to_string(&path).ok()?;
        let dc = crate::devcontainer::parse_devcontainer(&contents).ok()?;
        Some(crate::devcontainer::to_repo_hints(&dc, devcontainer_dir))
    });

    Ok(merge_config(&dual_config, dc_hints.as_ref()))
}
```

1. Reads `.dual.toml` at line 157 via `load_dual_config()` (returns defaults if missing)
2. Resolves devcontainer.json path at line 158 (explicit path or auto-detect)
3. Parses devcontainer.json at lines 161-166 if found (None if missing/invalid)

```rust
pub fn to_repo_hints(dc: &DevcontainerJson, devcontainer_dir: &Path) -> RepoHints {
    let mut hints = RepoHints::default();

    // Image (mutually exclusive with build)
    if let Some(ref image) = dc.image {
        hints.image = image.clone();
    }

    // Build → DockerfileBuild
    if let Some(ref build) = dc.build
        && build.dockerfile.is_some()
    {
        hints.dockerfile = Some(crate::config::DockerfileBuild {
            path: build
                .dockerfile
                .clone()
                .unwrap_or_else(|| "Dockerfile".to_string()),
            context: build.context.clone().unwrap_or_else(|| ".".to_string()),
            args: build.args.clone().unwrap_or_default(),
            target: build.target.clone(),
            base_dir: Some(devcontainer_dir.to_path_buf()),
        });
    }

    // Ports
    if let Some(ref ports) = dc.forward_ports {
        hints.ports = ports.iter().filter_map(|p| p.to_port()).collect();
    }

    // Environment variables
    if let Some(ref env) = dc.container_env {
        hints.env = env.clone();
    }

    // Setup command
    if let Some(ref cmd) = dc.post_create_command {
        let shell_cmd = cmd.to_shell_command();
        if !shell_cmd.is_empty() {
            hints.setup = Some(shell_cmd);
        }
    }

    // Anonymous volumes from mounts
    if let Some(ref mounts) = dc.mounts {
        let extra_volumes: Vec<String> = mounts
            .iter()
            .filter_map(|m| m.as_anonymous_volume())
            .collect();
        if !extra_volumes.is_empty() {
            for vol in extra_volumes {
                if !hints.anonymous_volumes.contains(&vol) {
                    hints.anonymous_volumes.push(vol);
                }
            }
        }
    }

    hints
}
```

**Field Mapping**:
- `image` → `hints.image` (lines 214-216)
- `build` → `hints.dockerfile` with `base_dir` set to devcontainer.json's directory (lines 219-232)
- `forwardPorts` → `hints.ports` after filtering/parsing (lines 235-237)
- `containerEnv` → `hints.env` (lines 240-242)
- `postCreateCommand` → `hints.setup` after converting to shell string (lines 245-250)
- `mounts` (anonymous volumes only) → merged into `hints.anonymous_volumes` (lines 253-265)

**Anonymous Volume Extraction** (`src/devcontainer.rs:133-167`):
Only extracts mounts that are:

Returns relative path like `"node_modules"` from `/workspace/node_modules`.

fn merge_config(dual: &DualConfig, dc_hints: Option<&RepoHints>) -> RepoHints {
    let base = dc_hints.cloned().unwrap_or_default();

    RepoHints {
        // Container fields come from devcontainer.json (or defaults)
        image: base.image,
        ports: base.ports,
        setup: base.setup,
        env: base.env,
        dockerfile: base.dockerfile,

        // Dual-specific fields come from .dual.toml
        extra_commands: dual.extra_commands.clone(),
        anonymous_volumes: dual.anonymous_volumes.clone(),
        shared: dual.shared.clone(),
    }
}

- Uses devcontainer.json as base (line 250), falling back to `RepoHints::default()`

- Orchestration fields (`extra_commands`, `anonymous_volumes`, `shared`) from `.dual.toml` (lines 261-263)

fn check_deprecated_fields(contents: &str, path: &Path) {
    let deprecated = [
        ("image", "image"),
        ("ports", "forwardPorts"),
        ("setup", "postCreateCommand"),
        ("[env]", "containerEnv"),
    ];

    for (old_field, new_field) in &deprecated {
        // Check for the field as a top-level key (not in a comment)
        for line in contents.lines() {
            let trimmed = line.trim();
            if trimmed.starts_with('#') {
                continue;
            }
            let matches = if *old_field == "[env]" {
                trimmed == "[env]"
            } else {
                trimmed.starts_with(&format!("{old_field} "))
                    || trimmed.starts_with(&format!("{old_field}="))
            };
            if matches {

# Research: DUAL-62 and DUAL-63 Implementation

**Date**: 2026-02-16T01:42:00+08:00
**Researcher**: Claude
**Git Commit**: 2525e7db88a2095e80cb64da35eaa07b3364438b
**Branch**: feature/dual-61-add-devcontainerjson-fallback-config-reader
**Repository**: dual

## Research Question
What is the current codebase state for implementing DUAL-62 (rename `dual add` to `dual init`) and DUAL-63 (`.dual/settings.json` config system)? What code needs to change, where does it live, and how do the pieces connect?

## Summary

Both tickets are part of the **v3.0 Architecture Rewrite** milestone. DUAL-62 is a CLI rename (`add` → `init`), and DUAL-63 replaces `.dual.toml` with `.dual/settings.json`. DUAL-62 blocks DUAL-64 (`dual init` interactive devcontainer setup), and DUAL-63 blocks both DUAL-64 and DUAL-65 (`load_hints()` migration). Neither ticket has been started yet (both in Backlog).

The codebase has 7 files and 26 specific locations that need modification across both tickets. The changes are largely mechanical (rename + re-serialize) but touch the entire config pipeline from CLI entry to runtime consumption.

## Detailed Findings

### DUAL-62: Rename `dual add` → `dual init`

#### 1. CLI Definition (`src/cli.rs:17-21`)

The `Add` variant in the `Command` enum:

```rust
Add {
    /// Short name for the repo (derived from directory name if omitted)
    #[arg(short, long)]
    name: Option<String>,
}
```

This is the clap-derived enum variant that defines the subcommand. It accepts an optional `--name` (or `-n`) flag.

#### 2. CLI Dispatch (`src/main.rs:58`)

```rust
Some(Command::Add { name }) => cmd_add(name.as_deref()),
```

Matches `Command::Add`, extracts the optional name, and calls `cmd_add()`.

#### 3. `cmd_add()` Function (`src/main.rs:129-223`)

The 95-line function that implements the add command. Steps:
1. **Lines 131-137**: Call `detect_git_repo()` to get `(repo_root, url, branch)`
2. **Lines 139-143**: Derive repo name from `--name` flag or directory name via `derive_repo_name()`
3. **Lines 145-152**: Load state from `~/.dual/workspaces.toml`
4. **Lines 154-158**: Check for duplicate workspace
5. **Lines 160-168**: Create `.dual.toml` if missing via `write_default_dual_config()`
6. **Lines 170-178**: Create `devcontainer.json` if missing via `write_default_devcontainer()`
7. **Lines 180-198**: Initialize shared directory if `[shared]` configured
8. **Lines 200-211**: Create `WorkspaceEntry` with `path: Some(repo_root)`
9. **Lines 213-217**: Save state to `~/.dual/workspaces.toml`
10. **Lines 219-222**: Print success messages

#### 4. User-Facing Messages Referencing "dual add"

| Location | Message | Context |
|----------|---------|---------|
| `src/main.rs:91` | `"Run \`dual add\` inside a repo to get started."` | No state file found |
| `src/main.rs:97` | `"No workspaces. Run \`dual add\` in a repo to get started."` | Empty state |
| `src/main.rs:246` | `"Or run from inside a repo that was added with \`dual add\`."` | Create command hint |
| `src/main.rs:255` | `"repo '{repo}' not found. Run \`dual add\` inside the repo first."` | Repo not found |
| `src/tui/ui.rs:34` | `"  No workspaces. Run \`dual add\` in a repo to get started."` | TUI empty state |
| `src/state.rs:35` | `"Explicit path to workspace directory (for \`dual add\`...)"` | Doc comment |
| `README.md:37` | `dual add` | Quick start section |
| `README.md:91` | `dual add [--name NAME]` | CLI commands table |

#### 5. Tests

| Test | Location | Current Name |
|------|----------|-------------|
| `add_subcommand()` | `src/main.rs:1076-1083` | Parses `["dual", "add"]` |
| `add_with_name()` | `src/main.rs:1086-1093` | Parses `["dual", "add", "--name", "myrepo"]` |

#### 6. Helper Function

`derive_repo_name()` at `src/main.rs:1009-1016` is used by `cmd_add()` but is not specific to the "add" naming — it just extracts a directory name from a path.

---

### DUAL-63: `.dual/settings.json` Config System

#### 1. Current `DualConfig` Struct (`src/config.rs:52-69`)

```rust
#[derive(Debug, Serialize, Deserialize, PartialEq, Clone)]
pub struct DualConfig {
    #[serde(skip_serializing_if = "Option::is_none")]
    pub devcontainer: Option<String>,
    #[serde(default)]
    pub extra_commands: Vec<String>,
    #[serde(default = "default_anonymous_volumes")]
    pub anonymous_volumes: Vec<String>,
    #[serde(skip_serializing_if = "Option::is_none")]
    pub shared: Option<SharedConfig>,
}
```

The ticket changes:
- `devcontainer`: `Option<String>` → `String` (required)
- `shared`: `Option<SharedConfig>` → `Vec<String>` (flattened, no nested struct)
- Serialization: TOML → JSON

#### 2. `SharedConfig` Struct (`src/config.rs:39-46`)

```rust
#[derive(Debug, Serialize, Deserialize, PartialEq, Clone)]
pub struct SharedConfig {
    #[serde(default)]
    pub files: Vec<String>,
}
```

The ticket eliminates this struct entirely, flattening `shared.files` to just `shared: Vec<String>`.

#### 3. Constants (`src/config.rs:36`)

```rust
const HINTS_FILENAME: &str = ".dual.toml";
```

Used at lines 173, 294, 316. The ticket replaces this with:
- `DUAL_DIR = ".dual"`
- `SETTINGS_FILENAME = "settings.json"`

#### 4. Config Loading (`src/config.rs:172-188`)

`load_dual_config()` reads `.dual.toml`:
1. Builds path via `workspace_dir.join(HINTS_FILENAME)`
2. Returns `DualConfig::default()` if file missing
3. Calls `check_deprecated_fields()` for warnings
4. Parses TOML via `toml::from_str()`

The ticket changes this to:
- Read `.dual/settings.json` instead
- Parse JSON via `serde_json::from_str()`
- Error if missing (user must run `dual init`)
- Remove deprecated field warnings (no longer applicable)

#### 5. Config Writing Functions

| Function | Location | Current Behavior |
|----------|----------|-----------------|
| `write_default_dual_config()` | `src/config.rs:269-297` | Writes commented TOML template to `.dual.toml` |
| `write_dual_config()` | `src/config.rs:315-320` | Serializes `DualConfig` to pretty TOML |

Both switch from TOML to JSON and write to `.dual/settings.json`.

#### 6. `load_hints()` Function (`src/config.rs:156-169`)

The merge function that combines DualConfig + devcontainer.json → RepoHints:

```rust
pub fn load_hints(workspace_dir: &Path) -> Result<RepoHints, HintsError> {
    let dual_config = load_dual_config(workspace_dir)?;
    let dc_path = resolve_devcontainer_path(workspace_dir, &dual_config);
    let dc_hints = dc_path.and_then(|path| { ... });
    Ok(merge_config(&dual_config, dc_hints.as_ref()))
}
```

The ticket changes:
- Reads `.dual/settings.json` instead of `.dual.toml`
- Uses explicit `devcontainer` path (required, no auto-detection fallback)
- Returns error if `.dual/settings.json` missing

#### 7. `resolve_devcontainer_path()` (`src/config.rs:229-243`)

Currently handles both explicit path and auto-detection. The ticket makes the `devcontainer` field required, so auto-detection at line 242 is removed.

#### 8. `merge_config()` (`src/config.rs:249-265`)

Merge strategy remains the same:
- Container fields from devcontainer.json
- Orchestration fields from `.dual/settings.json` (was `.dual.toml`)

#### 9. Deprecated Field Checker (`src/config.rs:191-224`)

`check_deprecated_fields()` scans `.dual.toml` for legacy container fields (`image`, `ports`, `setup`, `[env]`). This is no longer needed with the JSON migration since the new schema only has Dual-specific fields.

#### 10. HintsError Types (`src/config.rs:367-380`)

```rust
pub enum HintsError {
    ReadError(PathBuf, std::io::Error),
    WriteError(PathBuf, std::io::Error),
    ParseError(PathBuf, toml::de::Error),
    SerializeError(toml::ser::Error),
}
```

`ParseError` and `SerializeError` reference `toml::de::Error` and `toml::ser::Error`. These change to `serde_json::Error`.

#### 11. TOML Dependency (`Cargo.toml:22`)

```toml
toml = "0.8"
```

The `toml` crate is also used for global state (`~/.dual/workspaces.toml`) at `src/state.rs`, so it cannot be removed entirely. Only config-related TOML usage is removed.

#### 12. Callers of `load_hints()` Using `.unwrap_or_default()`

| Location | Context |
|----------|---------|
| `src/main.rs:181` | `cmd_add()` shared file initialization |
| `src/main.rs:390` | `cmd_launch()` workspace setup |
| `src/main.rs:766` | `cmd_shared()` sync operation |
| `src/proxy.rs:56` | Proxy route table building |
| `src/proxy.rs:284` | Proxy URL listing |

The ticket changes behavior: missing `.dual/settings.json` returns an error instead of defaults.

#### 13. `cmd_add()` Config File Creation (`src/main.rs:160-178`)

Currently creates two files:
1. `.dual.toml` (lines 160-168)
2. `.devcontainer/devcontainer.json` (lines 170-178)

The ticket replaces step 1 with creating `.dual/settings.json` and the `.dual/` directory.

#### 14. RepoHints Struct (`src/config.rs:86-119`)

The `RepoHints` struct itself doesn't change — it's the merge output. But its `shared` field currently holds `Option<SharedConfig>`. With DUAL-63's flattened `shared: Vec<String>`, `RepoHints.shared` may change to `Option<Vec<String>>` or remain wrapping the flat vector.

## Code References

### DUAL-62 Touch Points
- `src/cli.rs:17-21` — `Add` variant definition
- `src/main.rs:58` — CLI dispatch
- `src/main.rs:129-223` — `cmd_add()` function

### DUAL-63 Touch Points
- `src/config.rs:36` — `HINTS_FILENAME` constant
- `src/config.rs:39-46` — `SharedConfig` struct (removed)
- `src/config.rs:52-69` — `DualConfig` struct (modified)
- `src/config.rs:71-80` — `DualConfig::default()` (modified)
- `src/config.rs:156-169` — `load_hints()` (reads JSON)
- `src/config.rs:172-188` — `load_dual_config()` (reads JSON)
- `src/config.rs:191-224` — `check_deprecated_fields()` (removed)
- `src/config.rs:229-243` — `resolve_devcontainer_path()` (no auto-detect)
- `src/config.rs:249-265` — `merge_config()` (updated shared handling)
- `src/config.rs:269-297` — `write_default_dual_config()` (JSON template)
- `src/config.rs:301-312` — `write_default_devcontainer()` (unchanged)
- `src/config.rs:315-320` — `write_dual_config()` (JSON serialization)
- `src/config.rs:323-327` — `parse_dual_config()` (JSON parsing)
- `src/config.rs:367-380` — `HintsError` enum (JSON error types)
- `src/main.rs:160-178` — Config creation in `cmd_add()`
- `src/main.rs:181,390,766` — `load_hints()` callers
- `src/proxy.rs:56,284` — `load_hints()` callers
- `Cargo.toml:22` — TOML dependency (kept for state.rs)
- `README.md:103-155` — Configuration documentation

## Architecture Documentation

### Current Config Pipeline

```
User runs command
    ↓
load_hints(workspace_dir)
    ├── load_dual_config() → reads .dual.toml → DualConfig
    ├── resolve_devcontainer_path() → explicit or auto-detect
    ├── parse_devcontainer() → reads devcontainer.json → DevcontainerJson
    ├── to_repo_hints() → converts to RepoHints
    └── merge_config() → combines DualConfig + DevcontainerJson → RepoHints
    ↓
RepoHints consumed by:
    ├── container::create() — image, env, volumes
    ├── container::build_image() — dockerfile
    ├── container::exec_setup() — setup command
    ├── shell::write_rc_file() — extra_commands
    ├── proxy route building — ports
    └── shared::init_from_main() — shared files
```

### Post-DUAL-63 Config Pipeline

```
User runs command
    ↓
load_hints(workspace_dir)
    ├── load_dual_config() → reads .dual/settings.json → DualConfig (JSON)
    │   └── Error if missing (user must run dual init)
    ├── Uses explicit devcontainer path from DualConfig.devcontainer (required)
    ├── parse_devcontainer() → reads devcontainer.json → DevcontainerJson
    ├── to_repo_hints() → converts to RepoHints
    └── merge_config() → combines DualConfig + DevcontainerJson → RepoHints
    ↓
Same consumers as before
```

### Ticket Dependencies

```
DUAL-62 (rename add→init)     DUAL-63 (.dual/settings.json)
         \                        /          \
          \______________________/            \
                     |                         \
               DUAL-64                      DUAL-65
        (dual init interactive       (load_hints migration
         devcontainer setup)          to .dual/settings.json)
```

### Existing `.dual.toml` in This Repo

The repo has a `.dual.toml` at root with legacy format containing deprecated `image = "node:20"` field. This file would trigger deprecation warnings when loaded.

## Historical Context (from thoughts/)

- `thoughts/shared/plans/2026-02-15-v2-to-v3-roadmap.md` — The v2→v3 roadmap where these tickets were scoped. DUAL-62 and DUAL-63 are both v3.0 milestone items.
- `thoughts/shared/plans/2026-02-16-devcontainer-json-fallback.md` — The devcontainer.json fallback plan that was implemented on the current branch (DUAL-61). This is the predecessor work that makes DUAL-63's explicit devcontainer path viable.
- `REDACTED.md` — Original BUILD plan for the config module, documenting DualConfig and RepoHints struct design.
- `REDACTED.md` — Original BUILD plan for the CLI module, documenting the `Add` command variant.
- `thoughts/shared/research/2026-02-16-web-analysis-devcontainer-adoption.md` — Research on devcontainer.json adoption that informed the config architecture.

No existing thoughts documents specifically reference DUAL-62 or DUAL-63 ticket numbers.

## Related Research

- `REDACTED.md` — Config module research from initial build
- `thoughts/shared/research/2026-02-13-BUILD-cli.md` — CLI module research from initial build

## Open Questions

1. **SharedConfig consumers**: How many places access `hints.shared.files` vs `hints.shared`? The flattening from `Option<SharedConfig>` to `Vec<String>` affects all callers.
2. **Test fixture updates**: `tests/fixtures/mod.rs:124` calls `write_dual_config()` which currently writes TOML. All test fixtures need migration to JSON.
3. **Error behavior change**: Current callers use `.unwrap_or_default()` on `load_hints()`. Making missing `.dual/settings.json` an error changes behavior — should callers handle this differently?
4. **TOML retention**: The `toml` crate is kept for `state.rs` (global state). Should global state also migrate to JSON eventually?

#### 1. Current `DualConfig` Struct (`src/config.rs:52-69`)

```rust
#[derive(Debug, Serialize, Deserialize, PartialEq, Clone)]
pub struct DualConfig {
    #[serde(skip_serializing_if = "Option::is_none")]
    pub devcontainer: Option<String>,
    #[serde(default)]
    pub extra_commands: Vec<String>,
    #[serde(default = "default_anonymous_volumes")]
    pub anonymous_volumes: Vec<String>,
    #[serde(skip_serializing_if = "Option::is_none")]
    pub shared: Option<SharedConfig>,
}
```

The ticket changes:
- `devcontainer`: `Option<String>` → `String` (required)
- `shared`: `Option<SharedConfig>` → `Vec<String>` (flattened, no nested struct)
- Serialization: TOML → JSON

#### 2. `SharedConfig` Struct (`src/config.rs:39-46`)

```rust
#[derive(Debug, Serialize, Deserialize, PartialEq, Clone)]
pub struct SharedConfig {
    #[serde(default)]
    pub files: Vec<String>,
}
```

The ticket eliminates this struct entirely, flattening `shared.files` to just `shared: Vec<String>`.

#### 3. Constants (`src/config.rs:36`)

```rust
const HINTS_FILENAME: &str = ".dual.toml";
```

Used at lines 173, 294, 316. The ticket replaces this with:
- `DUAL_DIR = ".dual"`
- `SETTINGS_FILENAME = "settings.json"`

#### 4. Config Loading (`src/config.rs:172-188`)

`load_dual_config()` reads `.dual.toml`:
1. Builds path via `workspace_dir.join(HINTS_FILENAME)`
2. Returns `DualConfig::default()` if file missing
3. Calls `check_deprecated_fields()` for warnings
4. Parses TOML via `toml::from_str()`

The ticket changes this to:
- Read `.dual/settings.json` instead
- Parse JSON via `serde_json::from_str()`
- Error if missing (user must run `dual init`)
- Remove deprecated field warnings (no longer applicable)

#### 5. Config Writing Functions

|----------|----------|-----------------|
| `write_default_dual_config()` | `src/config.rs:269-297` | Writes commented TOML template to `.dual.toml` |
| `write_dual_config()` | `src/config.rs:315-320` | Serializes `DualConfig` to pretty TOML |

Both switch from TOML to JSON and write to `.dual/settings.json`.

#### 6. `load_hints()` Function (`src/config.rs:156-169`)

The merge function that combines DualConfig + devcontainer.json → RepoHints:

```rust
pub fn load_hints(workspace_dir: &Path) -> Result<RepoHints, HintsError> {
    let dual_config = load_dual_config(workspace_dir)?;
    let dc_path = resolve_devcontainer_path(workspace_dir, &dual_config);
    let dc_hints = dc_path.and_then(|path| { ... });
    Ok(merge_config(&dual_config, dc_hints.as_ref()))
}
```

The ticket changes:
- Reads `.dual/settings.json` instead of `.dual.toml`
- Uses explicit `devcontainer` path (required, no auto-detection fallback)
- Returns error if `.dual/settings.json` missing

#### 7. `resolve_devcontainer_path()` (`src/config.rs:229-243`)

Currently handles both explicit path and auto-detection. The ticket makes the `devcontainer` field required, so auto-detection at line 242 is removed.

Merge strategy remains the same:

- Orchestration fields from `.dual/settings.json` (was `.dual.toml`)

`check_deprecated_fields()` scans `.dual.toml` for legacy container fields (`image`, `ports`, `setup`, `[env]`). This is no longer needed with the JSON migration since the new schema only has Dual-specific fields.

#### 10. HintsError Types (`src/config.rs:367-380`)

```rust
pub enum HintsError {
    ReadError(PathBuf, std::io::Error),
    WriteError(PathBuf, std::io::Error),
    ParseError(PathBuf, toml::de::Error),
    SerializeError(toml::ser::Error),
}
```

`ParseError` and `SerializeError` reference `toml::de::Error` and `toml::ser::Error`. These change to `serde_json::Error`.

#### 11. TOML Dependency (`Cargo.toml:22`)

```toml
toml = "0.8"
```

The `toml` crate is also used for global state (`~/.dual/workspaces.toml`) at `src/state.rs`, so it cannot be removed entirely. Only config-related TOML usage is removed.

| `src/main.rs:181` | `cmd_add()` shared file initialization |
| `src/main.rs:390` | `cmd_launch()` workspace setup |

Currently creates two files:
1. `.dual.toml` (lines 160-168)
2. `.devcontainer/devcontainer.json` (lines 170-178)

## Analysis: `dual add` Command

### Overview

The `dual add` command registers the current git repository as a Dual workspace. It detects git repo information from the current directory, derives a repo name (optionally from the `--name` flag), creates default configuration files (`.dual.toml` and `devcontainer.json`), initializes shared file directories if configured, and saves the workspace entry to global state (`~/.dual/workspaces.toml`).

### Entry Points

- `/Users/jeevanpillay/Code/@jeevanpillaystudios/dual/src/cli.rs:17-21` — `Add` variant in `Command` enum
- `/Users/jeevanpillay/Code/@jeevanpillaystudios/dual/src/main.rs:58` — CLI dispatch matches `Command::Add` and calls `cmd_add(name.as_deref())`
- `/Users/jeevanpillay/Code/@jeevanpillaystudios/dual/src/main.rs:129-223` — `cmd_add()` function implementation

---

### Core Implementation

#### 1. CLI Definition (`src/cli.rs:17-21`)

```rust
Add {
    /// Short name for the repo (derived from directory name if omitted)
    #[arg(short, long)]
    name: Option<String>,
}
```

The `Add` variant accepts an optional `--name` (or `-n`) flag. The doc comment states that if omitted, the name is derived from the directory name.

#### 2. CLI Dispatch (`src/main.rs:58`)

```rust
Some(Command::Add { name }) => cmd_add(name.as_deref()),
```

The main function matches on `Command::Add`, extracts the optional `name` field, converts it to `Option<&str>` via `.as_deref()`, and passes it to `cmd_add()`.

#### 3. `cmd_add()` Function (`src/main.rs:129-223`)

**Step 1: Detect git repo info (lines 131-137)**
- Calls `detect_git_repo()` to get `(repo_root, url, branch)` from the current directory
- Returns exit code 1 if detection fails

**Step 2: Derive repo name (lines 139-143)**
- If `--name` flag provided, uses that value
- Otherwise calls `derive_repo_name(&repo_root)` which extracts the directory name via `path.file_name()` (implementation at `src/main.rs:1011-1016`)

**Step 3: Load or create state (lines 145-152)**
- Calls `state::load()` to load `~/.dual/workspaces.toml`
- Returns exit code 1 if state loading fails

**Step 4: Check for duplicates (lines 154-158)**
- Calls `st.has_workspace(&repo_name, &branch)` to check if workspace already exists
- Prints error `"workspace {}/{} already exists"` and returns exit code 1 if duplicate found

```rust
pub fn to_repo_hints(dc: &DevcontainerJson, devcontainer_dir: &Path) -> RepoHints {
    let mut hints = RepoHints::default();

    // Image (mutually exclusive with build)
    if let Some(ref image) = dc.image {
        hints.image = image.clone();
    }

    // Build → DockerfileBuild
    if let Some(ref build) = dc.build
        && build.dockerfile.is_some()
    {
        hints.dockerfile = Some(crate::config::DockerfileBuild {
            path: build
                .dockerfile
                .clone()
                .unwrap_or_else(|| "Dockerfile".to_string()),
            context: build.context.clone().unwrap_or_else(|| ".".to_string()),
            args: build.args.clone().unwrap_or_default(),
            target: build.target.clone(),
            base_dir: Some(devcontainer_dir.to_path_buf()),
        });
    }

    // Ports
    if let Some(ref ports) = dc.forward_ports {
        hints.ports = ports.iter().filter_map(|p| p.to_port()).collect();
    }

    // Environment variables
    if let Some(ref env) = dc.container_env {
        hints.env = env.clone();
    }

    // Setup command
    if let Some(ref cmd) = dc.post_create_command {
        let shell_cmd = cmd.to_shell_command();
        if !shell_cmd.is_empty() {
            hints.setup = Some(shell_cmd);
        }
    }

    // Anonymous volumes from mounts
    if let Some(ref mounts) = dc.mounts {
        let extra_volumes: Vec<String> = mounts
            .iter()
            .filter_map(|m| m.as_anonymous_volume())
            .collect();
        if !extra_volumes.is_empty() {
            for vol in extra_volumes {
                if !hints.anonymous_volumes.contains(&vol) {
                    hints.anonymous_volumes.push(vol);
                }
            }
        }
    }

    hints
}
```

- `build` → `hints.dockerfile` with `base_dir` set to devcontainer.json's directory (lines 219-232)
- `forwardPorts` → `hints.ports` after filtering/parsing (lines 235-237)
- `containerEnv` → `hints.env` (lines 240-242)
- `postCreateCommand` → `hints.setup` after converting to shell string (lines 245-250)

fn merge_config(dual: &DualConfig, dc_hints: Option<&RepoHints>) -> RepoHints {
    let base = dc_hints.cloned().unwrap_or_default();

    RepoHints {
        // Container fields come from devcontainer.json (or defaults)
        image: base.image,
        ports: base.ports,
        setup: base.setup,
        env: base.env,
        dockerfile: base.dockerfile,

        // Dual-specific fields come from .dual.toml
        extra_commands: dual.extra_commands.clone(),
        anonymous_volumes: dual.anonymous_volumes.clone(),
        shared: dual.shared.clone(),
    }
}

fn check_deprecated_fields(contents: &str, path: &Path) {
    let deprecated = [
        ("image", "image"),
        ("ports", "forwardPorts"),
        ("setup", "postCreateCommand"),
        ("[env]", "containerEnv"),

    for (old_field, new_field) in &deprecated {

        for line in contents.lines() {

            if trimmed.starts_with('#') {

            }
            let matches = if *old_field == "[env]" {

                    || trimmed.starts_with(&format!("{old_field}="))
            };
            if matches {
                warn!(
                    "{}: '{}' should be moved to devcontainer.json as '{}'. \
                     Container config fields in .dual.toml are deprecated.",
                    path.display(),
                    old_field,
                    new_field
                );
                break;
            }
        }
    }
}
